tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Day: Kafni Ivory, the white of Baba's kafni. Night: the dark of the sanctum behind Baba in his portraits.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, header, mobile action bar, inputs. One step lighter than surface by day, one step lifted by night.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Chandan (sandalwood). Alternate section bands (giving, footer), date tiles, map slot.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Diya glow. The one highlighted row or choice: next aarti, selected seva, logo disc. Holds ink, ink-muted, heading and link at AA.

tokens.name: sanctum
tokens.usage: Sannidhi, the darkness of the shrine. Ground of the hero and the one sanctum band (Live darshan and Baba's words) in both themes, and the fill behind Baba photos. Matches the feathered edge of murti-hero-wide.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Dhuni Ink. Body text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and glow-soft (13.2:1 or more day, 12.3:1 or more night).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Udi Ash. Secondary text, captions, meta, helper text on every surface (5.0:1 or more day, 6.5:1 or more night).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Section titles and the display face. Day: Sindoor maroon from Baba's red cloth (7.2:1 or more). Night: sandal light (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Deep Saffron. Inline links and quiet buttons on any surface (4.85:1 or more day, 7.5:1 or more night). Underline links in running text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the Donate item in the action bar. Day maroon, night saffron so the main action still glows on the dark ground.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill (8.4:1 day, 7.4:1 night).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Bhagwa, sampled from Baba's robe. Decorative only: halo, cover, the live play disc. Never text on ivory (2.7:1). Holds on-saffron text.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text or icon placed on a saffron fill, in both themes (5.5:1).

tokens.name: saffron-ui
tokens.usage: Saffron that carries meaning: fundraising fill, selected-choice border, meaningful icons, pinned event border. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: sindoor
tokens.usage: Brand maroon as a colour block (cover, print). In UI use heading or action instead.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Mukut Gold, from Baba's crown. Hairlines, the toran string, arch rings, kolam texture, meter milestone ticks. Ornament only: never text or a control border on ivory (2.3:1); on sanctum use gold-light for text.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Gold as text and rules on sanctum: the hero kicker, sanctum headings, Baba's words in the sanctum band (11.3:1 on sanctum).

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Genda, the marigold of every garland. Fill and mark only: toran flowers, the flame core, the lamp at the end of the meter, the lit dot of a chosen seva. Never text on ivory (1.9:1).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Mango leaf. Toran leaves only; nowhere else.

tokens.name: on-sanctum
tokens.usage: Headings and outline-button labels on sanctum (18:1).

tokens.name: on-sanctum-muted
tokens.usage: Lead and body text on sanctum (13.6:1).

tokens.name: action-sanctum
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on sanctum in both themes; label in on-action night ink #1A110C (7.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, row separators, header and bar edges. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, unselected seva choices, outline button, meter track (3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element (7:1 or more against the page in both themes).

tokens.name: open
tokens.usage: Tulsi green. The Open now dot and word. Always paired with the words Open now, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors with an icon and words. 5.3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The Live now dot on the status chip and live poster, always with the word Live. Alias of danger.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background; text stays ink.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Soft saffron glow behind the Darshan arch, like the light around Baba's raised hand. Radial gradient to transparent.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom gradient over imagery that carries text (live poster).

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text on scrim over photography.

families.display: "Tiro Devanagari Hindi", "Tiro Tamil", "Tiro Telugu", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Anek Latin", "Anek Devanagari", "Anek Tamil", "Anek Telugu", "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Tiro (Tiro Typeworks): a classical, calm serif designed with matching Devanagari, Tamil and Telugu companions. One weight, used sparingly: the H1, section titles, numerals of note and Baba's words.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Baba's home in the Bay Area
styles.usage: Hero H1 on phones. Grows fluidly to display-lg; never more than one per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Baba's home in the Bay Area

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section H2 on phones, in heading colour.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The raised amount in the fundraising meter; event day numerals at 34px.

styles.name: vachan
styles.sample: I shall be ever active and vigorous even after leaving this earthly body.
styles.usage: Baba's words. Italic, heading colour, centred, max 36 characters per line.

styles.name: signoff
styles.usage: The footer sign-off, Sabka Malik Ek, in heading colour, with the English line below in small.

styles.name: hero-mantra
styles.usage: The hero kicker Shraddha, Saburi in gold-light on sanctum (19px on phones).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Anek (Ek Type): one humanist family drawn together for Latin, Devanagari, Tamil and Telugu, so phase 2 languages need no new font decisions. 18px body so elders read without zoom.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Optional words beside the flame mark above a section heading, in link colour, sentence case. Only when they add information; the flame alone is the default.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: H3: event, seva and card titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A volunteer-run Shirdi Sai Baba mandir in Sunnyvale.
styles.usage: Hero subtext and one-sentence section intros, in ink-muted. 25 words at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: All are welcome for darshan, aarti and seva.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Aarti names, seva names, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Times and amounts in schedules and seva choices. Always tabular, lining numerals.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and action bar labels (action bar at 15px).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta, captions, helper text, footer. The smallest running text on the site.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro labels inside components only (event month, tags). Latin script only; never above a heading.

spacing.note: 4px base. Phones use the left half of the scale; sections breathe at space-8 (phones) and space-9 (desktop).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text nudges, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and buttons; between label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in the aarti list; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; gap between cards; card inner rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; tablet gutter; heading to content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; between a section head and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom from 1024px.

radius.note: Pill for things you press; 16px for things that hold; 10px for fields; the Dwarkamai arch (pill top, radius-sm or radius-md foot) for icon tiles, date tiles, photo frames and Baba's frame.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, date tiles, the map slot's inner badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, seva choices, highlighted rows, media (live poster, map), the arch's lower corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, segmented control, and the top of every arch (icon tiles, date tiles, carousel photos, DarshanFrame).

shadow.note: Warm and low. shadow-soft at rest, shadow-md for the Today strip and hovered cards, shadow-glow for lamp light.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards and the selected segment. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile action bar, cast upward.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The Today strip, hovered cards and the language menu.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Lamp light: primary button hover, the sanctum primary button at rest, the lit flame. The only glow besides the halo.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of section content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and tappable rows (WCAG 2.5.8 asks 24px; elders deserve 48).

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Sticky header height; also scroll-padding-top.

tokens.name: actionbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile action bar height plus safe area; also scroll-padding-bottom and footer bottom padding on phones.

tokens.name: hero-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the Sannidhi hero; it fills the viewport below the header up to 860px.

tokens.name: today-overlap
tokens.usage: How far the Today strip rises over the hero foot (56px on phones).

tokens.name: toran-h
tokens.usage: Height of the toran garland hanging under the header and over the footer.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Two-column sections, action bar hides, nav links show in header from 900px.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Display sizes switch to the -lg styles; gutters widen to space-6.

tokens.name: bp-hero-split
tokens.usage: From here the hero puts text left and Baba right over one wide photo; below it the photo sits on top and the text below, never over Baba.

duration.note: MOTION 3 of 10: feedback, state and lamp light only.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-calm
tokens.usage: The single section fade-in on scroll and the live poster swapping to the player.

tokens.name: dur-flicker
tokens.usage: The lit flame's gentle flicker while an aarti is live; off under reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: All transitions. Exponential ease-out from an already visible start.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-actionbar
tokens.usage: Mobile action bar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Language menu.
